2607.19261.title: PathAgentBench: Benchmarking Evidence-Seeking Vision-Language Models on Whole-Slide Pathology Image
2607.19261.paper_summary: Whole-slide image (WSI) diagnosis requires identifying diagnostically relevant regions, examining them across magnifications, and integrating multi-scale evidence. However, most existing pathology benchmarks evaluate models on pre-cropped patches or pre-extracted slide features, leaving their ability to acquire evidence directly from gigapixel WSIs largely untested. We introduce PathAgentBench, a benchmark for evaluating evidence-seeking vision-language models (VLMs) across four complementary capabilities: image-to-text matching for evidence interpretation, text-to-image retrieval for evidence verification, diagnostic-region localization for evidence acquisition, and multi-scale reasoning for evidence integration. The benchmark is organized as a diagnostic tree that links nested regions across magnifications with scale-specific findings and path-level diagnoses. It contains 1,822 TCGA WSIs and 17,135 diagnostic paths annotated by ten board-certified pathologists. An additional private cohort of 190 breast cancer WSIs with detailed annotations is used to evaluate autonomous whole-slide exploration. We evaluate 20 general-purpose, medical, and pathology-specialized models. Leading open-weight models achieve over 93% accuracy in multi-scale reasoning and over 50% accuracy in both cross-modal matching tasks. In contrast, diagnostic-region localization remains challenging: the best text-guided mean intersection-over-union is below 0.09, underperforming a simple center-based heuristic. During autonomous exploration, the unconditional hit rate decreases from 0.522 at low magnification to 0.185 at intermediate magnification and 0.020 at high magnification. These results reveal a pronounced gap between reasoning over curated evidence and acquiring that evidence directly from WSIs. PathAgentBench provides a unified framework for measuring and improving evidence-seeking pathology models.
2607.19261.paper_summary_zh: 整張幻燈片影像（WSI）診斷需要識別診斷相關區域，並在不同放大倍數下進行檢查，還要整合多尺度的證據。<lb/>然而，大多數現有的病理基準是在預裁剪的區塊或預提取的幻燈片特徵上評估模型，這使得它們從千兆像素WSI直接獲取證據的能力在很大程度上未經測試。<lb/>我們介紹了PathAgentBench，這是一個用於評估尋證視覺-語言模型（VLM）在四個互補能力上的基準：影像到文本匹配以進行證據解釋，文本到影像檢索以進行證據驗證，診斷區域定位以進行證據獲取，以及多尺度推理以進行證據整合。<lb/>該基準組織成一個診斷樹，將不同放大倍數下的嵌套區域與特定尺度的發現和路徑級診斷相連結。<lb/>它包含1,822個TCGA WSI和17,135條由十位董事會認證的病理學家註釋的診斷路徑。<lb/>另外，還有190個具有詳細註釋的乳腺癌WSI的私人隊列用於評估自主整張幻燈片探索。<lb/>我們評估了20個通用、醫療和病理專用的模型。<lb/>領先的開放權重模型在多尺度推理中達到超過93%的準確率，在跨模態匹配任務中則超過50%的準確率。<lb/>相比之下，診斷區域定位仍然具有挑戰性：最佳的文本引導平均交集比率低於0.09，表現不及一個簡單的基於中心的啟發式方法。<lb/>在自主探索過程中，無條件命中率從低放大倍數的0.522下降到中等放大倍數的0.185，以及高放大倍數的0.020。<lb/>這些結果揭示了在策劃證據的推理與直接從WSI獲取該證據之間存在明顯的差距。<lb/>PathAgentBench提供了一個統一的框架，用於測量和改進尋證病理模型。
